title: Random Question Types Practice
description: A sample quiz for trying every supported question interaction, including matching and rearranging.
subject: General practice

questions.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Iron-rich dust gives Mars its reddish appearance.

questions.question: Which C# keyword declares a method that does not return a value?
Which of these are C# value types? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: int, bool, and double are value types. string is a reference type.

questions.question: Which are valid HTTP methods? Select all that apply.
In C#, array indexes start at 1.
Match each C# type to a value it can represent.
questions.explanation: bool represents truth values, string stores text, and int stores whole numbers.

questions.question: Match each planet to its place from the Sun.
Arrange these steps for making a cup of tea in a sensible order.
options: Remove the tea bag and drink.
Put a tea bag in the cup.
Pour hot water into the cup.
answer: Put a tea bag in the cup.
Pour hot water into the cup.
Remove the tea bag and drink.

questions.question: Put these C# statements in the correct order to print a message.
questions.explanation: The using directive comes first, followed by the class and its statement.

questions.question: What is the capital city of Japan?
Type the exact C# statement that writes the number 5 to the console.
questions.explanation: This statement writes 5 followed by a new line.

questions.question: What exact text is printed by Console.Write("Hi");?
